tests.name: squad2
tests.title: SQuAD 2.0
tests.description: Wikipedia paragraphs with every crowd-written question on them, about half of which the paragraph cannot answer.

tests.name: cuad
tests.title: CUAD
tests.description: Windows of real commercial contracts with clause fields from CUAD's 41 lawyer-labelled categories, many of which the window does not contain.

tests.name: cord
tests.title: CORD v2
tests.description: Totals, taxes, payments and line items from the OCR text of 200 Indonesian shop and restaurant receipts.

tests.name: docs
tests.title: Business documents
tests.description: Synthetic invoices, receipts, emails, statements, bookings, logs and reports, each with 5-9 typed fields to read, compute or leave null.

tests.name: drop
tests.title: DROP
tests.description: Wikipedia and NFL-report passages with questions that need counting, arithmetic, sorting or dates, answered as numbers, dates or spans.

tests.name: tatqa
tests.title: TAT-QA
tests.description: Questions over financial report tables and their text, answered with exact numbers, text spans or lists of spans.

tests.name: fewnerd
tests.title: Few-NERD
tests.description: Every mention of a named-entity category (people, organizations, places, works, products, events and more) in short Wikipedia passages.

entries.name: Turion Extract alpha
entries.hardware: 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
entries.notes: Gemma 4 12B with a LoRA adapter and extraction heads: one forward pass, no generated tokens. Trained on the training splits of SQuAD 2.0, CUAD, CORD, DROP, TAT-QA and Few-NERD (the index scores their validation and test splits) and on synthetic documents from Turion AI's own generator, written without the index's docs generator, so docs is the only test outside its training domains. Those train splits also repeat 110 suite documents word for word (82 Few-NERD, 21 CORD, 7 DROP); scored without them the index is still 75.30. Run by Turion AI, one request at a time in BF16; latency is the local forward pass, with no network.

entries.name: Clairic (preview)
entries.notes: Run by the maintainers through the Workers AI REST API with default options, one request at a time from Europe, so latency includes the network round trip. Answers are scored as returned; list answers are not filtered by their confidence.

entries.name: Null baseline
entries.notes: Answers null for every field. This is the floor: each test scores its share of fields whose gold is null.
